descriptions.text: Upgrade Patch. Medium. This patch is finely made from Spider Reaper Minion thread silk. It's a bomb. You blow shit up all the time. It's appropriate you have a patch depicting it. This patch is finely made, which means all below upgrades are enhanced. If this upgrade patch is affixed to an eligible garment, it will imbue the following upgrades: +11% to Constitution. +6% damage to all explosives. +2 to the Dangerous Explosives Handling Skill. +15% Discount from traveling Spider Reaper Minion merchants. Warning: Upgrade patches are fleeting items. You may remove them, but they will be destroyed in the process.

beats.headline: Classic Spanish blackwork
beats.text: Carl expected a toe ring or foot lotion from the Gold Spicy Box. Instead he gets a second patch, a little bigger than the first: white, rectangular, with a little circular bomb hand-stitched in fine black thread, almost like a pencil drawing. Donut gasps and pulls it over to look. Exquisite, she says, classic Spanish blackwork. How would she know? Then it clicks: the useless hobby potion she got on the third floor, Scutelliphily, must be about patches, and Britney supplies the Latin, the love of small shields. The silk is Spider Reaper Minion thread. Carl hands Katia his jacket, and she starts mapping out where to sew the patches.

beats.headline: On the court's flag
beats.text: The Royal Court's capture flag is a little bigger than Carl's hand, and it is a miniature pair of heart-covered boxers flying sideways, as if off a clothesline. The court's name is embroidered top and bottom in motorcycle-club style, and centred over the crotch is a bomb patch identical to the one on Carl's jacket. It really is tacky. Imani's squad got a butterfly, Donut complains, and the stitching looks as if Carl sewed it.
